name: Quest log & objectives
oneLiner: Quests as data with ordered steps and counters: the game only reports what happened (kill, collect, talk, reach) and the module advances the right step, clamps every counter to its target, ignores events for later steps and after completion, and shows it all: a tracker card per quest in a HUD corner (current objective, 2/3 counter that punches, a bar, a finished step that checks off, strikes through and collapses), NEW QUEST / QUEST COMPLETE banners (or C-14 toasts), a full log panel with active and done tabs, descriptions, steps and rewards, and optional world markers with edge arrows. Never covers the HUD rects the game names; text never overlaps. Glass cards on HD canvases, crisp pixel cards with bitmap fonts on native pixel canvases.
fits: open-map and town games with errands
survival and crafting games (gather N, build M)
tactics and battle campaigns with objectives
notFor: arcade games with a single score goal (nothing to track)
narrative games whose objectives must stay hidden
branching quest graphs with choices inside a quest (steps are linear; branch by starting a different quest)

needs: quest data: id, title, giver, description, reward, ordered steps with 'type:target' and a count
events from the code that decides them: start(questId), event('kill' | 'collect' | 'talk' | 'reach' | any word, target, n)
the screen rect of the play view and the HUD rects to keep clear (dialogue boxes while open)
optional: quiet() = true while a dialogue or cut-scene runs (banners wait), obstacles() = screen rects of NPCs / speakers to keep visible
optional: camera world rect, target world positions and the player world position (markers, reach steps, banners off the player)
a fixed update step (also on the ?t= replay), a key for the log and arrow / confirm / cancel while it is open
provides: a drawn tracker, quest log, start / completion banners and world markers
quest state: status, current step, counts; callbacks onStart / onProgress / onStep / onComplete for rewards
rect() / rects() of what is on screen (UI rects for other overlays), busy() while the log is open
state(), lastDrawn() (cards, texts, banner, markers, log), stats() (applied and ignored events by reason)

params.label: Move away from the player and objectives

assets: module/quest-log.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_QuestLog): quest rules, tracker, log panel, banners, markers, placement clear of HUD rects, smooth and crisp drawing with built-in 6x8 and 5x6 bitmap fonts
no image, font or audio files
